description.value: You read the target's surface thoughts — what it is thinking about right now, not its history. Attempt an Occultism check against its Will DC. Signal +2 status to the check; on a failure, 2 force damage per level and +1 Signal Drift. Static no bonus, a free failure, and a success subject to the flat check. The worked example for the whole class: Signal buys a read you can plan on, Static is free to fish with and may hand you a guard's thought that the guard never had.
